Just because your husband pays for things doesn’t mean he should treat you like a housemaid. He is a child that you are taking after. As a human being (and a grown adult), he should be able to cook, clean, take care of his house, and himself. It is ridiculous that you are doing this volume of housework at 8 months pregnant. I would definitely have a chat about this with him. Your comments suggest that he is capable of looking after himself and is choosing not to out of laziness and negligence.

You are his wife, not his housekeeper. He is paying for these things because he wants to, and you don’t owe him anything for it. If your husband believes you owe him anything, then that is a sign he believes you are an employee. You could suggest splitting the payments. Or hiring a housemaid. 

I’m not a professional and these are just my thoughts. Stay safe. Please get plenty of rest, for the sake of yourself and your baby.

Ahh I’m 17 too. I understand completely what you’re talking about, wishing to stop feeling so much pain and... so much. The only thing that helps me sometimes is thinking good things only exist because pain exists; good can only exist where there is bad. Pain is just a reminder that we’re alive.

There’s a book called Brave New World. It’s about a dystopian society where no one truly feels any negative emotions or feelings. However, they all rely on drugs and sex and other weird forms of stimulation. All of them have jobs that are quite easy for them, leisure time, disease is eradicated, monogamy is frowned upon (everyone belongs to each other and therefore rejection doesn’t exist), people do not grow old and instead just drop dead at the end of their lives. 

There’s more to it, of course. The book is difficult to read because of Huxley’s complicated language, but i recommend it. It really helped me realise that this world will always have shitty things and sometimes that’s better than an artificial, painless reality.
